convert.queued_hint: Added to the conversion queue ({preset}). See the Convert tab.
convert.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg not found. Set it up in Settings.
library.empty_hint: Pair your phone on the Receive tab, then send from the phone.
jobs.title: Conversions
jobs.empty:
Click "Convert" in the library or viewer.
Originals are always kept; results go to the _converted folder in your library.
receive.title: Receive from phone
receive.no_port: No usable port (tried {ports}). Check whether security software is blocking LocalRoll.
receive.scan_title: Scan with LocalRoll on your phone
receive.scan_body: Your phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. After pairing once, the phone app finds this PC automatically.
receive.or_pin: Or enter this pairing code on your phone
receive.no_address: No local network address found. Check your network connection.
receive.firewall_button: Phone can't connect? Allow through firewall
receive.firewall_fail: Not added (administrator permission may have been declined)
settings.library_hint: Originals are stored by year/month; conversions go to the _converted subfolder.
settings.ffmpeg_title: ffmpeg (needed for HEIC display, thumbnails and conversion)
settings.ffmpeg_not_here: No working ffmpeg at this path
settings.ffmpeg_order: Search order: the path above → ffmpeg\ffmpeg.exe next to the app → system PATH. ffmpeg 7.1 or newer is required to decode iPhone HEIC correctly.
viewer.needs_ffmpeg: Showing {ext} requires ffmpeg. Set it up in Settings.
app.already_running: LocalRoll is already running. Use the open window (check the taskbar or the system tray) and close this one.
exit.title: Quit LocalRoll?
exit.body: Phones won’t be able to send to this PC until you open LocalRoll again.
exit.body_busy: {count} file(s) are still being received. Quitting stops them; the phone can resume later.
pair.check: Check that your phone shows the same three symbols, then allow.
identity.title: This PC
identity.preview_hint: This is how phones see this PC.
identity.name: Name
identity.picture_error: This picture can’t be opened. Try a JPG or PNG.
receive.tap_hint: On your phone, open LocalRoll and tap “{name}” — then click Allow here.
app.close_viewer: Close and go back to the library
settings.autostart_hint: Opens minimised, so phones can always send to this PC.
lib.delete_body: They go to the Windows Recycle Bin, so you can still restore them. Phones will be told next time they connect that these are no longer on this PC.
receive.blocked_title: Phones may not find this PC yet
receive.blocked_public: Windows Firewall hasn’t let LocalRoll in, and this Wi-Fi is set as a “Public” network. Allow it once (Windows will ask for permission).
receive.blocked_firewall: Windows Firewall hasn’t let LocalRoll in yet. Allow it once (Windows will ask for permission).
family.title: Family
family.hint: Each paired phone belongs to a family member. Several phones of one person are grouped and shown as “Anna 1”, “Anna 2”. The name comes from the phone and can be changed here.
family.folder_per_member_hint: New photos are saved as Name/Year/Month. Photos already received stay where they are. Tip: with a separate Windows account per person you can also restrict who may open each folder.
lib.offline: The library folder can't be reached ({path}) — external drive unplugged, or the folder moved? Receiving is paused and nothing is marked as deleted. It resumes by itself when the folder is back.
lib.missing_ask: {count} files are no longer in the library folder (deleted or moved in Explorer?). If you deleted them on purpose, confirm — the phones will then show them as no longer backed up.
